title: MapMyFitness Activity Average Heart Rate Leaderboard
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mapmyfitness:activity avg_hr_bpm=*
| stats sum(avg_hr_bpm) as total_value, avg(avg_hr_bpm) as avg_value by workout_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks workout type values by total and average average heart rate across MapMyFitness activity events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `avg_hr_bpm` values for each MapMyFitness activity event and review total and average average heart rate by workout type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total average heart rate.
grandmaExplanation: It will surface which workout type shows the biggest average heart rate numbers in your MapMyFitness activity data.
